ImageMagick CLI examples

Version:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd -version

Identify image:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd identify input.png

Verbose identify:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd identify -verbose input.png

Convert PNG to WebP:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd input.png -strip -quality 92 output.webp

Resize preserving aspect ratio:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd input.png -resize 1200x1200 output.webp

Fill/crop to exact square:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd input.png -resize 1200x1200^ -gravity center -extent 1200x1200 output.webp

Thumbnail:
  tools\toolbelt\third_party\imagemagick\bin\magick.cmd input.png -thumbnail 512x512 output.webp

Suite command examples:
  py tools\scripts\takesome.py image-identify --input assets\source.png
  py tools\scripts\takesome.py image-resize-fit --input assets\source.png --geometry 1200x1200 --output build\source.webp
  py tools\scripts\takesome.py image-thumbnail --input assets\source.png --geometry 512x512 --output build\thumb.webp
